title: War in Europe
text: The papers talk of nothing else. A newsreel company offers good money for your cameras and crews to film the mobilisation.

options.label: Rent out the crews
options.detail: Quick cash, but your own pictures look neglected.

options.label: Keep making pictures
options.detail: Audiences want an escape. A small boost to your name.

title: The Pictures Start Talking
text: A rival's picture with synchronized singing has crowds queuing round the block. Some call it a fad. Within three years, silent films may be unsellable.

options.label: Wire the stages for sound now
options.detail: Pay a premium and get Synchronized Sound immediately.

options.label: Wait and see
options.detail: Research it yourself when you are ready. Cheaper, slower.

title: The Crash
text: The stock market has collapsed. People still go to the pictures to forget, but there is less money in every pocket for the next few years.

options.label: Cut everyone's pay
options.detail: Save cash now. Your reputation with talent suffers.

options.label: Hold the line
options.detail: Keep the payroll whole and earn loyalty.

title: The Little Box
text: Television sets are in millions of homes and ticket sales are sliding. Audiences will only leave the sofa for something they cannot get at home.

options.label: Sell old films to television
options.detail: A welcome cheque from the networks.

options.label: Refuse to feed the enemy
options.detail: Stay exclusive to theatres. Cinemas reward your loyalty.

title: Strike!
text: Writers and actors have walked out, demanding a share of what television pays for old films. The lot is silent.

options.label: Settle generously
options.detail: It costs money, but the talent remembers.

options.label: Wait them out
options.detail: Lose six months while the stages stand empty.

title: The Summer Everything Changed
text: One picture opened everywhere at once and people queued for hours. The summer event film is born, and the market for spectacle has never been bigger.

options.label: Chase the spectacle
options.detail: The market for films grows for the next decade.

options.label: Champion the auteurs
options.detail: Smaller growth, but critics love your stand.
